detail: Initial audit expected 24 verified request bodies, but the frozen population contains 72 request bodies across 24 Public-only and 48 Privileged rows. No source rows were removed; corrected verification count is 72.

A transient edit changed the registered protocol after registration. The edit was detected before analysis, restored byte-for-byte, and the protocol SHA-256 was rechecked against the registered frozen-input hash. No model/API calls occurred during the drift.

The v2 audit omitted a per-pair determinate sequence-element comparison, did not require both relevant ballots to follow acceptance, and marked ballots present without checking all actors. Added deterministic checks and positive/order/missing-ballot counterexamples; v2 artifacts remain unchanged.

The first repair checked public ballot presence only in the Privileged branch. A final code review applied the same all-actor ballot-presence check to Public-only and Privileged projections; the unchanged frozen population was rerun and the output hash remained identical.

First researchctl close attempt rejected the schema-v2 closure because its frozen v1 compatibility validator also requires a non-empty scientific_update field. The closure proposal now includes the same narrowly scoped claim and retains zero calls; no registered hypothesis, threshold, evidence, or outcome was changed.
